name: sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate
purpose: Nat Phos 6X ...... acid indigestion, sour stomach, sore joints
uses: Helps temporarily relieve: occasional acidity; burning sensations in the chest; gastric and urinary tract discomfort; upset stomach; and sore, swollen, or painful joints.
otcwarn: Keep out of reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen. If you have severe symptoms, consult a doctor before use.
